written_by: Claude, from the clip's burned-in captions and a frame contact sheet, before running the pipeline. Not a trainer's list; test data only. Clip has no spoken narration.

steps.text: Remove the two screws on the rear panel.
Remove the side panel screws; note they are different sizes.
Gently pull both side panels apart.
Remove the screws holding the graphics card.
Pull the old graphics card out of its slot.
Insert the new graphics card and push lightly until it clicks into place.
